documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting

analysis.summary: During the financial year ended March 31, 2026, Amal Ltd experienced strong revenue growth driven by significant price realizations in its core sulphur-based products, though profitability was impacted by higher input costs. Standalone revenue increased by 74% to ` 8,491 lakh while consolidated revenue rose by 77% to ` 23,964 lakh. However, profit before tax declined due to the inability to fully absorb the 164% spike in the price of sulphur. The company maintained a debt-free status with an increased cash surplus and recommended a higher dividend of 15% for the year. Amal Ltd reported a significant improvement in its consolidated performance for FY 2024-25, with sales increasing by 57% to Rs 135 crore and PBT increasing 11-fold to Rs 33 crore.
